$comment: Holder-facing failure copy for wallet interaction. Keyed on code, never messageKey. Twenty distinct codes share wallet.interaction.error.action_not_allowed, and oid4vp.request_uri_expired shares a key with oid4vp.request_uri_fetch_failed despite different dispositions. Only codes where a holder learns something the disposition does not say have byCode entries; the rest of the 120 engine codes fall back to byDisposition. Consumers resolve locally in the device locale. Do not populate WalletInteractionError.message from this file.

TERMINAL.en: The exchange could not be completed, and it cannot be picked up again. Start a new one when you are ready.

REPEATABLE.en: The exchange did not get through. Nothing was shared or received, and it is worth trying again.

RESUMABLE.en: The exchange stopped part way through. It is still open and can be continued.

iso18013.reader_blocked.en: This reader is not accepted by your wallet, so nothing was shared.

iso18013.transport_unavailable.en: The reader could not be reached. Check that the connection is on and try again.

oid4vci.issuer_blocked.en: This issuer is not accepted by your wallet, so nothing was issued.

oid4vci.offer_parse_failed.en: This offer could not be read. Ask the issuer for a new one.

oid4vp.request_uri_expired.en: This request has expired. Ask the verifier for a new one.

oid4vp.request_uri_fetch_failed.en: The verifier could not be reached. Nothing was shared.

oid4vp.request_uri_not_found.en: This request is no longer available. Ask the verifier for a new one.

oid4vp.selection_unsatisfiable.en: None of your credentials match what was asked for, so there was nothing to share.

oid4vp.verifier_blocked.en: This verifier is not accepted by your wallet, so nothing was shared.

wallet_interaction.no_adapter.en: This wallet does not support the kind of code or link that was captured.
